text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship seemed a bit under the weather,
so I took her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Are you awake, our Lord, Great King Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This has gotta be a dream!?

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
"So fast?!
N-N-No way, I couldn't possibly!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a dream, it's totally a dream!!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Boring! I'm getting up right now!

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Huh?! *The* Golshi-sama did that?! Anything is possible in dreams, which makes them super fun, yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You blockhead!
I can do whatever the hell I want in reality, too!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Except for just one thing—races, that is!

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Th-The background turned into an emotional sunset sky!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since I can remember, I've been easily bored.
It was always start something, get bored, and repeat.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"At a time like that, what I encountered was racing.
Racing, you know, is incredible."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing ever goes the way you want!
And not a single race is ever the same!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's 'cause... each and every one of 'em
is running with everything they've got.

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Golshi-sama...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —And so, a wake-up blow: Electric Shockーーー!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Gyoeee~~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Heh,
that electric shock managed to snap me out of that dream safely.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My love for racing knows no bounds!
Guess I'll go ahead and host the Golshi Memorial Cup~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship left the infirmary with a light bounce in her step.

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Are you awake, our Lord, Great King Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Still dreaming!?
Electric SHOOOOOCK!

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Are you awake, our Lord, Gol—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaaat—?!
Wake up, wake up, wake uuuup!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
I finally managed to wake up from that dream...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm seriously exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship wasn't able to get enough rest.
